rows_semantics: one row per actual source and method; source index is consumer20 ordinal; missing axes absent/None mean NOT_RUN or inapplicable, not zero

studies.quality: 8 axes 14 results on two videos; single-source I2V axes separate

studies.scope: historically exposed; data collection not candidate test

studies.kernel_execution: NOT_RUN in asset scope; distinct QAT distilled checkpoint and recipe

interpretation: Do not infer motion from latent SSE or combine numeric-family baselines. Source clusters are independent units; rows/frames/sites/seeds nested. Human acceptance and fair latency remain open.

next_experiment.design: Freeze one full160 raw BF16 W2 candidate and paired original BF16 Dense for at least 20 distinct development image clusters, stratified by subject action/background/static/camera availability; same source, prompt, noise and recipe, one seed each first, then at least second seed. Fit only permitted calibration clusters and record exposure; no site or per-source result-based selection.
next_experiment.quality: Prespecify per-axis acceptable loss and tails; actual 81-frame videos, applicable imaging/aesthetic/I2V, continuous motion, action/ROI and camera where applicable, human review. Preserve NOT_RUN axes and 5 genuine generations for official five-sample claims.
next_experiment.cost: Record full FFN/GEMM/observer/packing/offload, complete wall, setup, peak memory, balanced order and warm/cold; quality and latency assessed together.
next_experiment.confirmation: Pre-register disjoint source confirmation; 48 clusters (20 subject/20 background/8 camera) target only, subject to availability and prior exposure audit.
